**Finding: Compliant (preferred position) — no redline proposed.**

The Agreement imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching restriction on Northwind. I searched the full document for "solicit", "recruit", "induce", "hire", and "employ", and reviewed the three sections where such a covenant would normally sit (§ 12 Customer Responsibilities, § 16 Confidentiality, § 30 General). Nothing of the kind appears — the planner's `likelyAbsent` hint is borne out.

Two points worth noting for the file:

- **§ 12.3 is affirmatively helpful to us.** It preserves Customer's freedom to hire anyone responding to general recruitment and expressly records that Customer has made "no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment." That is better than the fallback (which would have tolerated a mutual 12-month narrow non-solicit) and should be protected in any redline exchange — if Brightline later proposes a non-solicit, § 12.3 would need conforming amendment, which gives us a natural point of resistance.
- **§ 12.4 runs the other way and is not flagged.** It bars Vendor from developing or marketing a service competing with Customer's proprietary analytics during the term. That is a restrictive covenant burdening the counterparty for our benefit, so under the direction rule it is left alone.

No action required on NOSOLICIT.
